messages:
emma_sales: Heads up — Acuity Health (procurement) asking for 40% off on a 12mo dedicated commit. POC scheduled next Tue, need pricing + SQA cleared by EOD tomorrow.

raj_se: Do we have the commit $/month and model footprint?

emma_sales: Rough ACV ~$720k (60k/mo). They want private deployment + dedicated pool.

luis_dealdesk: @emma_sales please send exec sponsor + deal rationale. Our standard for 12mo dedicated is usually 20–30% with minimums. If they want 40% we need CRO signoff + docatio.

emma_sales: Quick teaser I sent them:
```
commit_months: 12
monthly_commit: 60000
requested_discount: 40%
billing_terms: net30
onboarding_credit: 0
```

maria_revops: Note — 25% is typically our upper bound for this product without CRO approval. Upfront payment can stretch it to ~35% in precedent. Also check quota/comp implications.

olga_ps: PS: onboarding + runbook + 2w hypercare included in scope. That adds ~50k of PS effort in Q1. Need to reflect that in pricing.

luis_dealdesk: Ok — @maria_revops @raj_se can you surface any comps where we exceeded 30% for similar infra and PS load? I'll need ARR, PS cost, and payment terms to justify escalation.

raj_se: We did 35% once for MedSys (18mo + upfront) — had 2x prefund months. I'll pull the redacted term sheet and numbers.

capacity-bot: :warning: projected dedicated capacity for us-west2 is at 92% for the next quarter. No guaranteed burst unless we reserve extra nodes.

emma_sales: Customer can do 12mo upfront if that helps. My thought: offer 30% standard, 35% if paid upfront, 40% only with CRO signoff. What do you need from me to route?

luis_dealdesk: Proposed approval path: 30% — deal desk OK to sign; 35% — require upfront payment + RevOps signoff; 40% — CRO approval + Legal review. @emma_sales send SOW + PO + expected start date and I'll escalate.

maria_revops: Also require a floor: min monthly commit $50k to protect unit economics. Add termination clauses for capacity reallocation.

emma_sales: Will update quote with the three-tier offer (30/35/40) + floor & PS line item, attach SOW/PO, and ping back when uploaded. Thanks all :thumbsup:
